name: Mutate — a merged permanent counts once in creature counts and mana value totals
notes: Gemrazer is mutated over Grizzly Bears: one permanent with Gemrazer's characteristics (CR 702.140e), though the engine keeps a state for each card. _computeForEachCount counted every card of the stack, so Crusader of Odric saw four creatures (4/4) and Ancient Ooze added the buried Bears' mana value 2 (9/9). Now the cards under the top card are left out of counts: Crusader counts itself, Gemrazer and the Ooze (3/3), and the Ooze adds Crusader 3 and Gemrazer 4 (7/7).
